request: Does the sofa colour go with the floor? Explain the visible palette and one optional small improvement. Do not change anything.

reply.message:
The sage-green sofa suits the room’s warm, earthy palette: a sandy beige rug, walnut and oak furniture, terracotta chair and brass accents, balanced by creamy walls.

I can’t confirm the floor pairing specifically—the supplied scene has no floor colour or rendered image. If it’s warm-toned wood, sage should complement it nicely.

One optional small improvement: a slightly lighter cream rug could give the sofa more definition. Nothing has been changed.
